question: Me ___ el café. (I like coffee)

question: Me ___ los gatos. (I like cats)
explanation: Gustar agrees with the thing liked: plural → gustan. Literally: Me gustan los gatos. = “to-me please the cats”.

question: ¿Dónde ___ tú? (Where do you live?)

question: Mi madre ___ profesora. (My mother is a teacher)

question: Estas son ___ amigas. (These are my friends)

question: Yo vivo ___ Madrid. (I live in Madrid)

question: Ayer ___ al cine. (Yesterday I went to the cinema)

question: Ayer ella ___ pizza. (Yesterday she ate pizza)
explanation: Regular -er preterite: comí, comiste, comió, comimos, comisteis, comieron. Literally: Ayer ella comió pizza. = “yesterday she ate pizza”.

question: Anoche nosotros ___ en casa. (Last night we were at home)
explanation: Estar has an irregular preterite stem: estuv-. Literally: Anoche nosotros estuvimos en casa. = “last-night we were at home”.

question: El año pasado ___ a México. (Last year I travelled to Mexico)
explanation: Regular -ar preterite: viajé, viajaste, viajó… Literally: El año pasado viajé a México. = “the year last travelled-I to Mexico”.

question: De niño, ___ al parque cada día. (As a child I went to the park every day)

question: Cuando era pequeña, ___ mucho. (When I was little, I played a lot)

question: Mientras ___, sonó el teléfono. (While I was cooking, the phone rang)

question: Mañana ___ a llover. (It's going to rain tomorrow)

question: El año que viene ___ a España. (Next year I will go to Spain)

question: Mañana ___ calor. (It will be hot tomorrow)

question: Yo me ___ a las siete. (I wake up at seven)

question: Ella se ___ temprano. (She gets up early)

question: Nosotros nos ___ los dientes. (We brush our teeth)

question: A Pablo ___ doy un regalo. (I give Pablo a present)
